subject: Missing invoice VEN041-0021 in GSTR-2B
body:
Dear Titan Logistics Ltd team,

We are reconciling our purchases and found that invoice VEN041-0021 dated 18 Sep 2025 is not shown in your GSTR-2B for Sep 2025 or the following month. Rs 355 of input tax credit is at risk.

Please report the invoice in your return and let us know once it appears. We will hold the credit note until then.

Regards,
Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
